notes: Cited ref 10.1128/jb.163.1.94-105.1985 (Felmlee 1985, PMID 3891743) is the E. coli chromosomal hemolysin SEQUENCE paper; organism matches and the quote is verbatim in its abstract, but it describes cistron order and molecular masses, NOT secretion (fails STRICT). Felmlee abstract has no secretion sentence. Proposed Mackman/Nicaud/Gray/Holland 1985 Mol Gen Genet (PMID 3003531, DOI 10.1007/BF00425672): abstract states hlyA product secreted into medium and hlyB/hlyD essential for export; proposed_quote verbatim from that abstract.

Organism Pasteurella (Mannheimia) haemolytica leukotoxin LktA; secretion shown via heteroplasmid complementation by HlyB/HlyD (E. coli host), a heterologous T1SS export assay (flagged strain_diff: secretion demonstrated in E. coli expressing P. haemolytica LktA). Quote verbatim in abstract: "a heteroplasmid complementation system was developed that permits secretion of the leukotoxin from cells expressing the hemolysin transport proteins HlyB and HlyD".

Ref 10.1016/j.gene.2006.10.004 = Crosby & Kachlany 2007 Gene (PMID 17116373, PMCID PMC1831674). Organism Aggregatibacter actinomycetemcomitans matches. Composite quote; all three fragments verbatim in abstract: "produces leukotoxin (LtxA), a member of the RTX family of toxins"; "an outer membrane channel-forming protein, TolC, is required for toxin secretion"; "requires a TolC-like protein for LtxA secretion". TdeA(TolC)-knockout mutant "did not secrete LtxA" = secretion-machinery-dependent export. Strong.
